name: r13-i-e3-rows-tail
author: solx-loop
description: H43 rows: r12's tcgen05 pass 1 (fixed warp roles, TMA x ring, resident W1', 8 epilogue warps with LN fold, A&S erfc GELU, sumsq and staged fp16 h stores), followed by the notebook tail (K0 weight prep plus gsum zeroing in the call; K3 per-image fp16 W2_b with b2' hi/lo columns; cuBLASLt batched swap-AB GEMM2 with beta 1 on x). It beats G's mma.sync pipeline at 64,96 and 32,128 because the pass-1 gain is not eaten by the tail. Measured, same container vs r12-merge: 744.1 vs 854.8 us (-12.9 %) and
